|date=4 July 2022}} [[Bali United F.C.|Bali United]] were the two-time defending champions. == Summary == Following the [[Kanjuruhan Stadium disaster]], in which at least 135 people were killed in a stampede provoked by police use of tear gas among fans who were still in the stadium, competition in all top three leagues in Indonesia were placed on hold.{{Cite web |last=Ardiansyah |first=Mohammad Naufal |title=Bertambah Satu, Korban Tragedi Stadion Kanjuruhan Jadi 133 Orang|url=https://www.timesindonesia.co.id/read/news/432832/bertambah-satu-korban-tragedi-stadion-kanjuruhan-jadi-133-orang |access-date=2022-10-18 |website=TIMES Indonesia |language=id}} On 8 October 2022, [[FIFA]] recommended that matches be played no later than 17:00 [[Time in Indonesia|local time]] and only on weekends to avoid risky situations in some matches.{{cite news|url=https://sport.detik.com/sepakbola/liga-indonesia/d-6336624/5-perintah-fifa-agar-sepakbola-indonesia-lebih-baik/2|title=5 Perintah FIFA Agar season ended.{{cite web |title=Liga 1 dilanjutkan mulai 5 Desember 2022|trans-title='Liga 1' resumes from 5 December |last=Siahaan |first=Michael |editor-first=Yuniati|editor-last=Jannatun Naim|language=id|location=[[Riau Islands]]}} ==Teams== Eighteen teams were competing in the league – the top fifteen teams from the previous season and the three teams promoted from the [[2021–22 Liga 2 (Indonesia)|Liga 2]]. The promoted teams were [[Persis Solo|Persis]] (returned to the top flight after fourteen years), [[RANS Nusantara F.C.|RANS Nusantara]] and [[Dewa United F.C.|Dewa United]] (both teams will play in the Liga 1 for the first time in their history). They replaced [[Persipura Jayapura|Persipura]], [[Persela Lamongan|Persela]] (both teams were relegated for the first time since 2008) and [[Persiraja Banda Aceh|Persiraja]] (relegated after just two seasons back in the top flight).{{cite web |title=Daftar Tiga Tim Liga 1 yang Degradasi dan Tiga Tim Liga 2 yang Promosi - Semua Halaman |url=https://www.bolasport.com/read/313213778/daftar-tiga-tim-liga-1-yang-degradasi-dan-tiga-tim-liga-2-yang-promosi?page=all |website=Bolasport|access-date=1 April 2022 |language=id |date=31 March 2022}} ===Name changes=== On 30 May 2022, during the 2022 PSSI Ordinary Congress, four teams had their name change requests accepted by the federation:{{cite web |title=Sejumlah Klub Direstui Kongres PSSI Berganti Nama |url=https://www.pssi.org/news/sejumlah-klub-direstui-kongres-pssi-berganti-nama |website=PSSI |access-date=31 May 2022 |language=id |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220531043637/https://www.pssi.org/news/sejumlah-klub-direstui-kongres-pssi-berganti-nama |archive-date=31 May 2022 |url-status=dead}} * '''[[Dewa United F.C.|Dewa United]]''' removed "Martapura" from its official name, having previously acquired [[Martapura F.C.|Martapura]] to play in Liga 2 last season. * Borneo added their home city of "Samarinda" to their full name, thus becoming '''[[Borneo F.C.
